sections.Profile:
Bullfight, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in January 1965, is an electromechanical pinball machine designed by Ted Zale. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, seven mushroom bumpers, and three slingshots.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1965
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Violence, Sports, Original Theme, Bullfighting, Animals
